name: ARCTIC
tagline: 2.1M frames (8 static + 1 ego views) of 10 subjects manipulating articulated objects bimanually, with MANO, SMPL-X and dense contact GT.

annotations.format: NPY per sequence (mano / smplx / object / egocam) + JSON meta + 2K images
annotations.coverageNote: Every frame has MANO hand meshes, SMPL-X body, 7-D articulated object pose and egocentric camera pose from a 54-camera Vicon MoCap; contact fields derived.

object_boxes.note: 3D object box corners + their 2D projections in processed splits; no plain 2D boxes

segmentation.note: Masks renderable from GT with the provided scripts, not shipped

hand_pose.note: MANO rot / pose / trans / shape per frame, both hands; 21 joints per view in splits

body_pose.note: SMPL-X params per frame (body, jaw, eyes, hands)

object_pose.note: 7-D pose (1 articulation + 3 rot + 3 trans) + object templates / meshes

camera_pose.note: Egocentric camera R/T per frame + intrinsics (egocam.dist.npy); static cams in meta

depth.note: Depth renderable from GT with scripts, not captured

annotations.sample:
# raw_seqs/s01/box_grab_01.mano.npy
  rot         : frames x 3    # MANO global rotation (axis-angle)
  pose        : frames x 45   # MANO pose params
  trans       : frames x 3    # global translation
  shape       : frames x 10   # MANO shape
  fitting_err : frames
# raw_seqs/s01/box_grab_01.object.npy
  frames x 7                  # 1 articulation + 3 rot (axis-angle) + 3 trans
# raw_seqs/s01/box_grab_01.egocam.dist.npy
  R_k_cam_np : frames x 3 x 3   T_k_cam_np : frames x 3 x 1   intrinsics : 3 x 3   dist8 : 8

samples.caption: Allocentric + egocentric frames, bimanual MANO meshes, changing contact and object articulation
